notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wP-059) and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and none was attached. The card's GymnasiumDriver helper fits the upstream Gym environment, so there is no deviation from the card. The native entry symbol custom_envs.envs:Capping_Env was verified at custom_envs/envs/Insertion_PandaTasks/Capping/Capping_PandaTask.py:13. The package serves Capping-v1 (ee/sparse) only: the other registered envs and the other entry symbols of the card (EmptyRackInsertion_Env, LoadedRackInsertion_Env, VialInsertion_From_LoadedRack_to_Rack_Env, VialInsertion_From_Rack_to_Rack_Env) are not covered. NOT COVERED: rendering (human or rgb_array 720 x 480) because cap.world.* binds no render class; the observation and goal arrays are carried at their real sizes (16 observation values, 6 desired and 6 achieved goal values), not truncated. PyBullet, gym, gym_robotics, numpy and the mesh files were not installed (no network), so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in: it was not compared with the upstream PyBullet environment, and the sim backend (gym.make of the registered Capping-v1) was not run. The fake does not model contacts, mass, friction, the mesh scene, the cap-holder contact reward or the seed behaviour of the upstream task (which draws placement offsets from Python's global random, Capping_Task.py:172-173); it follows the old Gym four-tuple step and applies the registration's 100-step limit through done, so the bridge reports that tick as terminated rather than truncated. The fidelity contract states the upstream PyBullet physics timestep 2 ms with 50 substeps (100 ms control interval) and the fake's kinematic gaps. Two kinds of warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family package: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer and simulator-derived inputs (seed twice, action.values, ticks). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
